sources.title: Paul Ricoeur and Sorin Antohi, Memory, History, Forgiveness: a dialogue (conversation 10 March 2003; English journal version 2005)
sources.note: PDF pages 1–7 read (running headings 9–14 after opening); includes forgiveness/justice, testimony/archive and historical scales. Translation credited to Gil Anidjar; recording transcribed/edited by Mona Antohi, with interlocutors’ revisions. English journal version is 2005, not the 2003 conversation. PDF cover citation and running pagination differ, so locators use PDF pages and phrases. Remaining PDF unread. Public download required bypass of a hostname-mismatched certificate.

substantive_relations.relationship: Distinguishes recollective recognition from the critical comparison of testimonies and documents in historical knowledge.
substantive_relations.note: Own dialogue, PDF pp. 4–5, passage from recognition to the archive; testimony is fallible and can be criticized. Personal forgiveness is explicitly distinguished from state amnesty and judicial impunity in PDF pp. 1–3. Book body unread.

substantive_relations.relationship: Uses movement between historical scales to think about determination, uncertainty and actors’ limited horizons.
substantive_relations.note: Own dialogue, PDF pp. 5–7, discussions of Revel, Braudel and Menocchio. This is an epistemological resource attributed to Ricoeur, not a claim that he practised or founded microhistory, or independent verification of his account of other historians.

limits: Selected theoretical contributions and dated texts, with original, revised, translated and posthumous forms distinguished. Source notes state actual reading extent; no complete monograph or comprehensive reception survey is claimed. Existing collective relationships and source/roster qualifications remain.
